This article is for customers
Pet care and lounge access

The Companion Animal Travel Desk helps travelers keep pets comfortable before departure and while moving through the airport. We share practical guidance so you can plan ahead, stay calm, and avoid last-minute surprises.

If you are bringing a pet to Aurelia Skyways, check in early and keep your documents close. Staff may ask about carrier size, feeding notes, and any comfort items your animal needs. Clear communication helps the crew prepare the right space and reduces delays at the desk.

<<FACT F019>> When you arrive, follow the posted signs and speak with the nearest agent if you need help finding the lounge. Keep your pet secured until you are invited inside, and use the area only for its intended purpose.

For relief area access, use the directions given by airport staff and watch for entry instructions near the correct terminal zone. <<FACT F016>> If your pet needs a break, stay with them, clean up after them, and return to the gate area promptly. Travelers should keep leashes, carriers, and waste supplies ready so the visit stays smooth for everyone.

A few simple habits make the trip easier. Offer water when appropriate, avoid noisy handling, and give your pet a quiet moment before boarding. If you are traveling with more than one animal, separate their supplies so each pet has what it needs without confusion. The Companion Animal Travel Desk also recommends that you confirm any special handling notes as soon as you reach the airport.

If you need more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk before you travel or speak with an Aurelia Skyways agent at the airport.
